stratum_basis: UPGRADED FROM PENDING, 16 Nov 2026, BUT ON A DERIVED COMPARISON RATHER THAN A PUBLISHED ONE -- READ THE CAVEAT. Tsiolaki et al. 2019 (J Struct Biol 207:260) ran AMYLPRED2, an 11-method consensus, over the whole LECT2 sequence BEFORE any structure existed, and nominated two aggregation-prone regions: 38-58 and 73-88. The cryo-EM core determined four years later is 55-75. COMPUTED OVERLAP: only 7 of the 21 core residues were predicted, and those seven are the two ENDS (55-58 and 73-75). THE ENTIRE 14-RESIDUE CENTRE, 59-72 (QEKPYQNKNAINNG), WAS NOT PREDICTED. AND THE MISSED STRETCH IS THE STRUCTURALLY IMPORTANT ONE. Richards 2023 names the residues that hold the core together: the polar ladders Q59, N65, N67 and N71, the central I69 that "anchors the very center of the fibril core", and the G58/G72 pair. Of these, Q59, N65, N67, I69, N71 and G72 are ALL in the missed stretch. The predictor found the hydrophobic flanks and missed the polar machinery.
